ColonyCouncil.AlmanacArticleDef.label: What Rimfolk does with your mods
ColonyCouncil.AlmanacArticleDef.summary: Which of the mods Rimfolk works with are in this game, and what it does with each
ColonyCouncil.AlmanacArticleDef.description:
Rimfolk works on its own, and with any mod list. Some mods it knows by name: it reads them while the game runs, writes events, encounters, wishes and journal lines for them, and keeps out of their way where they already do something. Nothing here is a requirement. When a mod is missing, Rimfolk's content for it simply never comes up.
The tables below are made from what Rimfolk finds when the game starts: the first lists the mods it found and how much of its own content is written for each, the second the ones it knows but didn't find. If a mod is found but Rimfolk couldn't read it (an update may have changed it), the table says so, and the self-check in the debug actions has the details. The other pages in this part of the Almanac explain the mods themselves.
